Package edu.cnu.mdi.mapping.theme

Class MapTheme.Builder

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.mapping.theme.MapTheme.Builder
Enclosing class:
MapTheme
public static final class MapTheme.Builder extends Object
Mutable builder for MapTheme.

All setter methods return this to support fluent chaining. Stroke widths are clamped to ≥ 0 to prevent negative values being stored.
